listings.title: Cosy room in Schwabing WG — 3 friendly flatmates
listings.description: Bright room in a well-kept flat in Schwabing. We are two working professionals and a student looking for a friendly flatmate. U-Bahn nearby.
listings.ai_rank_reason: Excellent city proximity (3.8km from Marienplatz) with utilities included keeps total cost well under budget. Small friendly WG with only 2 current flatmates — ideal for a student wanting social balance without a crowded flat. Furnished is a bonus.
listings.draft_message: Hello! I came across your listing for the room in Schwabing and I'm very interested. I'm a master's student at TUM Munich studying Microelectronics and Chip Design — I keep clean common areas, enjoy cooking, and love being part of a welcoming flat community without being in everyone's way. I'm looking for a stable, longer-term arrangement starting in June. Would it be possible to arrange a viewing? Looking forward to hearing from you!

listings.title: WG room near Sendlinger Tor — 4 international students
listings.description: Room in a lively international student flat near Sendlinger Tor. Great location, U3/U6 direct to city. Utilities not included — estimated ~€85/mo.
listings.ai_rank_reason: Superb city location (1.2km from Marienplatz) — you'd have Munich on your doorstep. However utilities push the total to ~€825 which slightly exceeds budget, and the flat of 4 is on the upper edge of your preference. Unfurnished means startup costs. Worth a look if you can negotiate.
